senses.en: Feeling glad, cheerful, and full of joy.

ex.en: The little dog looks very happy when it sees me.
ex.zh: 这只小狗看到我的时候看起来非常开心。

ex.en: All the students feel happy because our class won the singing contest at school.
ex.zh: 所有同学都感到很开心，因为我们班赢得了学校的歌唱比赛。

tip: happy的反义词是sad（伤心的），比较级要把y变i再加-er。

senses.en: Feeling unhappy or wanting to cry because something bad happened.

ex.en: Don't be sad; we can fix your broken toy car.
ex.zh: 别伤心，我们可以把你坏掉的玩具车修好。

ex.en: Tom felt sad when his pet rabbit got lost, so his friends helped look for it.
ex.zh: 汤姆的宠物兔走丢时他很伤心，于是朋友们帮着一起找。

col: a sad story｜一个悲伤的故事
tip: 字母a在闭音节中发/æ/音，表达“别伤心”可以说Don't be sad.

ex.en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
ex.zh: 有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。

ex.en: Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 市政委员会决定关闭社区唯一的图书馆，居民们对此感到愤怒。

tip: 生某人的气用angry with；因某事生气用about。

ex.en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。

ex.en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
ex.zh: 经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。

col: too tired to concentrate｜累得无法集中注意力
tip: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

ex.en: The boy carefully carried his puppy across the puddle.
ex.zh: 那个男孩小心地抱着小狗跨过水坑。

ex.en: Every boy and girl should have equal access to education, regardless of their family's income.
ex.zh: 无论家庭收入如何，每个男孩和女孩都应享有平等的受教育机会。

col: a teenage boy｜十几岁的男孩
tip: 通常指未成年男性；称成年男性为boy可能不礼貌。

ex.en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
ex.zh: 那个女孩小心翼翼地把小猫抱进屋里。

ex.en: Ensuring that every girl can attend school is essential for reducing inequality and supporting economic development.
ex.zh: 确保每个女孩都能上学，对于减少不平等和促进经济发展至关重要。

tip: 成年女性正式称woman；girl不直接表示女朋友。

senses.en: The person or people that someone is talking or writing to.

ex.en: Thank you for helping me carry these heavy books today.
ex.zh: 谢谢你今天帮我搬这些沉重的书。

ex.en: If you water the little green plant every week, it will grow tall and strong.
ex.zh: 如果你每周都给这棵小绿植浇水，它就会长得又高又壮。

tip: you既可指“你”，也可指“你们”，搭配be动词时都要用are。

senses.en: the form of "be" used with you, we, they, or plural nouns

ex.en: My two little cats are very cute and love sleeping.
ex.zh: 我的两只小猫非常可爱，还很喜欢睡觉。

ex.en: Green trees and clean rivers are important parts of nature for all living animals.
ex.zh: 绿色的树木和清澈的河流对所有动物来说都是大自然的重要部分。

tip: be动词之一，主语为you、we、they或复数名词时都要用are。

senses.en: A word used to make a sentence or verb negative, meaning "no".

ex.en: I am not hungry now because I ate some bread.
ex.zh: 我现在不饿，因为我吃了一些面包。

ex.en: That small animal in the tree is not a bird; it is a brown squirrel.
ex.zh: 树上的那只小动物不是鸟，而是一只棕色的松鼠。

tip: not常放在be动词或助动词后面构成否定，可缩写为n't。

senses.en: used by the speaker to refer to himself or herself

ex.en: I like eating sweet red apples after my lunch.
ex.zh: 我喜欢在午饭后吃又红又甜的苹果。

ex.en: Every Friday afternoon, I water the small green plants in our classroom corner.
ex.zh: 每周五下午，我都会给教室角落里的绿色小植物浇水。

tip: 人称代词“I”无论放在句首还是句中，都必须永远大写。

senses.en: the form of the verb "be" used after "I"

ex.en: I am seven years old and in Grade One.
ex.zh: 我今年七岁了，在读一年级。

ex.en: I am very proud to help my classmates clean the science room.
ex.zh: 我很自豪能帮同学们一起打扫科学教室。

col: I am a student.｜我是一名学生。
tip: “am”只和主语“I”搭配使用，在口语中常缩写为“I'm”。

ex.en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
ex.zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。

ex.en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。

tip: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。

senses.en: A short word used to say yes, agree to a plan, or show everything is fine.

ex.en: OK, let us clean the classroom desks together after school.
ex.zh: 好的，放学后我们一起把教室的课桌擦干净吧。

ex.en: The teacher asked if we understood the science rule, and everyone said OK loudly.
ex.zh: 老师问我们是否听懂了这个科学规律，大家都大声说“好”。

col: OK, let's go!｜好的，我们走吧！
tip: OK通常两个字母都大写，也可以写成okay，用来表示同意或赞成。

ex.en: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
ex.zh: 你平安到家后请告诉我。

ex.en: Schools should let students explore different subjects before requiring them to choose a specialist pathway.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生先探索不同学科，再要求他们选择专业方向。

tip: let sb do sth中不加to；过去式、过去分词均为let。

ex.en: I finally found my keys inside my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我终于在外套口袋里找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 许多学生觉得网络课程很方便，但有些人在缺少课堂互动时难以保持学习动力。

col: find a solution｜找到解决办法
find it difficult to｜觉得做某事困难
a valuable find｜有价值的发现物
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为found；find＋宾语＋形容词。

ex.en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 她削好铅笔，开始画那只熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Using a pencil allows students to revise diagrams easily as their understanding of scientific concepts develops.
ex.zh: 使用铅笔让学生能随着对科学概念理解的加深，轻松修改图示。

tip: 用铅笔写说in pencil；pencil in指暂定安排。

senses.en: A word used before a singular noun to mean "one" or "any one".

ex.en: I see a cute cat and an orange ball here.
ex.zh: 我在这里看见一只可爱的猫和一个橙色的球。

ex.en: In our science corner, we have a small microscope and an interesting book about planets.
ex.zh: 在我们的科学角里，有一台小显微镜和一本关于行星的有趣的书。

tip: 看音不看字母：辅音音素前用a，元音音素前用an。

ex.en: This soup is too hot to eat now.
ex.zh: 这汤现在太烫，还不能喝。

ex.en: Public transport cannot attract more passengers if fares are too high for regular commuters.
ex.zh: 如果票价对日常通勤者而言过高，公共交通就无法吸引更多乘客。

col: too tired to work｜累得无法工作
tip: too强调超过合适程度；very只强调程度高。

ex.en: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
ex.zh: 我们一到家就开始做晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。

col: at the start of｜在……开始时
make a fresh start｜重新开始
tip: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

ex.en: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
ex.zh: 你能再说一遍，稍微慢一点吗？

ex.en: If cities fail to address the causes of congestion, the same transport problems will occur again.
ex.zh: 如果城市不解决交通拥堵的成因，同样的交通问题就会再次出现。

tip: again表示重复；again and again强调反复多次。

ex.en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
ex.zh: 我们做饭、听音乐，度过了这个晚上。

ex.en: Evening classes allow working adults to gain new qualifications without giving up their current employment.
ex.zh: 晚间课程让在职成年人无需辞去现有工作，也能获得新的资格证书。

tip: 泛指晚上用in the evening；this evening前不加介词。

senses.en: To shut a window so wind or rain cannot come inside.

ex.en: It is getting cold, so please close the window now.
ex.zh: 天气变冷了，请现在把窗户关上吧。

ex.en: Before the heavy rain starts, the monitor asks everyone to close the window in class.
ex.zh: 大雨开始前，班长请大家把教室里的窗户关上。

col: please close the window｜请关上窗户
close the window tightly｜把窗户关紧
open and close the window｜开关窗户
tip: 作动词“关”时，close中的s发/z/音，反义词组是open the window。

senses.en: To turn your eyes toward the board in front of the classroom.

ex.en: Boys and girls, please look at the blackboard and read.
ex.zh: 同学们，请看黑板并跟读。

ex.en: When our math teacher writes new numbers, all students look at the blackboard carefully.
ex.zh: 数学老师写新数字时，所有学生都会仔细看黑板。

col: look at the blackboard carefully｜仔细看黑板
please look at the blackboard｜请看黑板
tip: “看某物”时look后要加介词at；blackboard是合成词“黑板”。

senses.en: A polite greeting you say to someone when you meet them in the morning.

ex.en: Good morning, Miss Li! You look very happy today.
ex.zh: 早上好，李老师！您今天看起来很开心。

ex.en: Every day at the school gate, students smile and say good morning to their teachers.
ex.zh: 每天在学校大门口，学生们都会微笑着向老师道上午好。

col: Good morning, class!｜同学们上午好！
tip: 用于早晨到中午十二点前的问候，别人对你说时可用同样的句子回应。

senses.en: A friendly question asking if someone is feeling well today.

ex.en: Hello, Amy! How are you? Have you had breakfast yet?
ex.zh: 你好，艾米！你好吗？你吃过早饭了吗？

ex.en: When we meet our friends at the school gate, we smile and ask, "How are you?"
ex.zh: 我们在校门口见到朋友时，常会微笑着问：“你好吗？”

tip: 这是熟人见面常用的问候语，注意句末用问号，回答常用I'm fine.

senses.en: A polite answer to "How are you?" meaning you feel well and are thankful.

ex.en: "How are you today, Ben?" "Fine, thank you. And you?"
ex.zh: “本，你今天好吗？”“很好，谢谢。你呢？”

ex.en: When the nurse asked if Tim felt better after resting, he smiled and said, "Fine, thank you."
ex.zh: 校医问蒂姆休息后有没有好些时，他微笑着回答：“很好，谢谢。”

col: I'm fine, thank you.｜我很好，谢谢你。
tip: 用于回答How are you?，最后还可以加上And you?反问对方。

ex.en: My grandfather taught me how to grow tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的祖父教过我如何种番茄。

ex.en: A grandfather who provides regular childcare can strengthen family bonds and support working parents.
ex.zh: 经常帮忙照顾孩子的祖父或外祖父能够增进家庭感情，并为在职父母提供支持。

tip: 不区分父系母系；外祖父可说maternal grandfather。

senses.en: The father of your mother or father; an affectionate word for grandfather.

ex.en: My grandpa likes drinking warm tea and reading newspapers.
ex.zh: 我爷爷喜欢喝热茶和看报纸。

ex.en: Every weekend, grandpa walks with me in the park and tells stories about the past.
ex.zh: 每个周末，爷爷都和我一起在公园散步，讲过去的故事。

col: my dear grandpa｜我亲爱的爷爷
tip: grandpa口语中可指爷爷或外公，书面正式一点可以说grandfather。

ex.en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 我的祖母在厨房窗台上种新鲜的香草。

ex.en: For many working parents, a grandmother provides essential childcare and helps maintain strong family connections.
ex.zh: 对许多在职父母来说，祖母或外祖母提供了不可或缺的育儿帮助，也有助于维系紧密的家庭关系。

tip: 可指祖母或外祖母；口语常用grandma。

senses.en: The mother of your mother or father; an affectionate word for grandmother.

ex.en: My grandma makes sweet apple pies for our big family.
ex.zh: 我奶奶为我们大家庭做香甜的苹果派。

ex.en: During the Spring Festival, grandma teaches me how to cut red paper flowers by hand.
ex.zh: 春节期间，奶奶教我怎样亲手剪红色的窗花。

col: my kind grandma｜我善良的奶奶
tip: 注意字母d在grandma中通常不发音，读作/ˈɡrænmɑː/。

ex.en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can allow fathers to take a more active role in raising their children.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以让父亲更积极地参与养育子女。

col: the father of modern medicine｜现代医学之父
tip: father较正式，dad更口语化；父亲节用Father's Day。

ex.en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。

ex.en: Affordable childcare can help a mother return to work without placing excessive pressure on the family budget.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务能帮助母亲重返职场，而不给家庭预算带来过大压力。

tip: 英式口语常用mum，美式口语常用mom。

ex.en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
ex.zh: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。

ex.en: Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
ex.zh: 经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。

tip: sister不分姐姐妹妹；需用older或younger说明年龄关系。

ex.en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
ex.zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的自行车。

ex.en: Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.
ex.zh: 哥哥姐姐可以通过经常在家陪弟弟妹妹阅读来帮助他们学习。

tip: brother不区分兄弟；用older或younger说明长幼。

senses.en: the object form of "I", used after a verb or preposition

ex.en: Please give me that blue ruler on your desk.
ex.zh: 请把你桌子上的那把蓝色尺子递给我。

ex.en: My science teacher asked me to hold the glass bottle during the experiment.
ex.zh: 我的科学老师让我在做实验时拿住那个玻璃瓶。

tip: “me”和“I”都表示“我”，但“me”通常用在动词或介词后面。

ex.en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。

ex.en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。

tip: family作整体用单数；英式英语强调成员时可用复数。

ex.en: I left my umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 我把我的伞放在前门旁边了。

ex.en: In my view, cities should prioritise affordable housing rather than invest heavily in prestigious construction projects.
ex.zh: 在我看来，城市应优先提供可负担住房，而非大量投资于彰显声望的建设项目。

col: to my surprise｜令我惊讶的是
tip: my后须接名词；mine可独立使用，表示“我的”。

senses.en: Used to show a person or thing that is close to you right now.

ex.en: This is my new blue pencil case on the desk.
ex.zh: 这是我放在课桌上的新蓝色铅笔盒。

ex.en: In our museum visit, this is an old clay pot from thousands of years ago.
ex.zh: 在我们参观博物馆时，看到的这是一个几千年前的古陶罐。

tip: this指代离说话人较近的单数人或物，复数形式是these（这些）。

ex.en: I bought fresh bread and cheese for our picnic.
ex.zh: 我为我们的野餐买了新鲜面包和奶酪。

ex.en: Governments should invest in public transport and encourage cycling to reduce congestion in growing cities.
ex.zh: 政府应投资公共交通并鼓励骑行，以缓解发展中城市的交通拥堵。

tip: 连接并列成分时注意结构一致；口语常弱读/ən/。

senses.en: used to refer to a girl or woman already mentioned

ex.en: She is my best friend and she dances well.
ex.zh: 她是我最好的朋友，她跳舞跳得很好。

ex.en: My sister loves nature, so she keeps a diary about garden birds daily.
ex.zh: 我姐姐热爱大自然，所以她每天都写关于花园小鸟的日记。

tip: “she”指代女性“她”，不要和男性的“he”混淆，注意“sh”发音。

senses.en: used to refer to a boy or man already mentioned

ex.en: He is my older brother and he likes swimming.
ex.zh: 他是我的哥哥，他非常喜欢游泳。

ex.en: My uncle works in a museum, and he knows many ancient dinosaur stories.
ex.zh: 我的叔叔在博物馆工作，他知道许多古老的恐龙故事。

tip: “he”指代男性“他”，是第三人称单数，后面动词要搭配“is”或加“s”。

senses.en: used in questions to ask about a person's name or identity

ex.en: Who is that smiling girl standing near the door?
ex.zh: 站在门旁边的那个微笑着的女孩是谁？

ex.en: Who can tell the class the name of this famous Chinese poem?
ex.zh: 谁能告诉全班同学这首著名中国古诗的名字？

tip: “who”专门用来对“人”提问，其中的字母“w”不发音，读作/huː/。

ex.en: My twin and I share a love of swimming.
ex.zh: 我的双胞胎手足和我都喜欢游泳。

ex.en: Studies involving identical twins help researchers understand how genes and environment influence human development.
ex.zh: 涉及同卵双胞胎的研究有助于研究人员了解基因和环境如何影响人的发育。

tip: a twin指双胞胎中的一人；twins指两人。

ex.en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
ex.zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。

ex.en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
ex.zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。

tip: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex.zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。

ex.en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。

tip: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
ex.zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。

ex.en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

tip: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

ex.en: She closed her eyes and listened to the rain.
ex.zh: 她闭上眼睛，听着雨声。

ex.en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
ex.zh: 设计师需要善于观察细节，才能打造既美观又便于所有人使用的公共空间。

col: keep an eye on｜留意；照看
an eye for detail｜对细节的敏锐观察力
catch someone's eye｜引起某人的注意
tip: an eye for表示鉴赏力；keep an eye on表示照看。

ex.en: My ears felt cold, so I pulled on a hat.
ex.zh: 我的耳朵觉得冷，于是我戴上了帽子。

ex.en: Regular exposure to loud music can damage the ears and lead to permanent hearing loss.
ex.zh: 经常接触高音量音乐可能损伤耳朵，并导致永久性听力损失。

col: an ear for music｜音乐辨音能力
an ear of wheat｜一穗小麦
tip: have an ear for表示善于辨听音乐、语言等。

ex.en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
ex.zh: 牙医让我把嘴张大一点。

ex.en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
ex.zh: 河口附近的湿地提供了宝贵的栖息地，也有助于保护沿海社区免遭洪灾。

col: the mouth of a river｜河口
tip: 名词末音为/θ/；动词末音为/ð/。

ex.en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
ex.zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。

ex.en: Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.
ex.zh: 一些工作场所正在放宽对发型和服装的规定，以营造更包容的环境。

col: a strand of hair｜一缕头发
tip: 整体头发不可数；一根头发用a hair。

ex.en: My nose turned red in the cold wind.
ex.zh: 我的鼻子在冷风中冻红了。

ex.en: Wearing a mask over the nose and mouth can reduce exposure to airborne dust.
ex.zh: 戴口罩遮住口鼻可以减少吸入空气中的灰尘。

col: the nose of an aircraft｜飞机机头
tip: 擤鼻涕用blow your nose，不用clean。

ex.en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
ex.zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。

ex.en: Many coastal cities face increasing risks from flooding as sea levels rise and extreme weather becomes more frequent.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升和极端天气日益频繁，许多沿海城市面临越来越大的洪水风险。

tip: 面对困难可说face difficulties或be faced with difficulties。

ex.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。

ex.en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
ex.zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。

tip: 说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。

ex.en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
ex.zh: 她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。

ex.en: Long commuting times can reduce workers' leisure opportunities and negatively affect their overall quality of life.
ex.zh: 长时间通勤会减少劳动者的休闲机会，并对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。

col: long to do something｜渴望做某事
tip: 动词long后接for加名词，或to加动词原形。

ex.en: The bag looks small, but it holds everything I need.
ex.zh: 这个包看起来小，却装得下我需要的所有东西。

ex.en: Public transport can reduce traffic congestion, but services must be reliable enough to attract regular users.
ex.zh: 公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，但服务必须足够可靠，才能吸引经常乘坐的乘客。

col: not only ... but also ...｜不仅……而且……
tip: although与but通常不在同一句中成对使用。

ex.en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
ex.zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。

ex.en: Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.
ex.zh: 许多居民喜欢附近有绿地，因为绿地提供了锻炼和放松的机会。

col: feel like doing something｜想做某事
tip: would like to do 比 want to do 更礼貌。

ex.en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
ex.zh: 我能看见树梢上方有一道彩虹。

ex.en: When students see how science applies to everyday life, they often become more interested in learning.
ex.zh: 当学生理解科学如何应用于日常生活时，他们往往会对学习更感兴趣。

col: see someone's point｜理解某人的意思
tip: 过去式saw，过去分词seen；强调看见而非观看。

ex.en: We live near the station now, so walking is easy.
ex.zh: 我们现在住在车站附近，步行过去很方便。

ex.en: Now that online courses are widely available, more adults can continue their education while working.
ex.zh: 既然在线课程已广泛普及，更多成年人就能在工作的同时继续接受教育。

tip: now that引导原因从句，强调情况已发生变化。

ex.en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
ex.zh: 过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。

ex.en: Students who sit for long periods should take regular breaks to support their physical health.
ex.zh: 长时间坐着的学生应定期休息，以维护身体健康。

col: sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

ex.en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
ex.zh: 她把一把椅子拉到离窗户更近的地方。

ex.en: An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.
ex.zh: 应由一位独立专家主持会议，确保所有参与者都能公平地发表意见。

tip: chair作动词直接接meeting，表示主持会议。

ex.en: Could you please hold the door for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我扶一下门吗？

ex.en: Public policies designed to please every group may fail to address the most urgent social problems.
ex.zh: 旨在取悦所有群体的公共政策，可能无法解决最紧迫的社会问题。

tip: please是动词；感到满意用be pleased。

senses.en: to own, hold, or possess something

ex.en: I have two big eyes and a small nose.
ex.zh: 我有两只大眼睛和一个小鼻子。

ex.en: We have a lively music class every Wednesday morning in the big hall.
ex.zh: 每周三上午我们在大礼堂里有一节热闹的音乐课。

tip: 主语是“I/you/we/they”时用“have”，第三人称单数要变成“has”。

ex.en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。

ex.en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
ex.zh: 短期培训课程能帮助失业成年人获得实用技能，而不必投入数年时间学习。

tip: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意为“不久”。

senses.en: A common, loving word for mother, especially in British English.

ex.en: My mum buys fresh fruit and milk every Tuesday morning.
ex.zh: 我妈妈每周二早上都会买新鲜水果和牛奶。

ex.en: After school, mum helps me check my English homework and packs my schoolbag cleanly.
ex.zh: 放学后，妈妈帮我检查英语作业，并把我的书包整理干净。

col: my dear mum｜我亲爱的妈妈
tip: mum是英式英语常用拼写，美式英语里常拼作mom。

senses.en: A friendly compliment telling someone that they look very nice or healthy.

ex.en: Wow, you look great! That new red jacket fits you well.
ex.zh: 哇，你看起来真棒！那件新的红夹克很适合你。

ex.en: Before the school concert started, Emma smiled at her classmate and said, "You look great!"
ex.zh: 学校音乐会开始前，埃玛朝同学笑了笑说：“你看起来真棒！”

tip: 这是称赞别人外表或精神状态的好句型，听到时应礼貌回答Thank you!

senses.en: To jump lightly over a turning rope again and again for exercise or play.

ex.en: The girls love to skip happily in the playground after lunch.
ex.zh: 女孩子们喜欢午饭后在操场上开心地跳绳。

ex.en: In our PE test, Leo can skip more than one hundred times in one minute.
ex.zh: 在体育测试中，利奥一分钟能跳绳超过一百次。

tip: 动词“跳绳”，现在分词需双写p变成skipping。

ex.en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
ex.zh: 今天早饭前，我们跑步穿过了公园。

ex.en: Local councils often run training programmes to help unemployed residents develop skills needed by employers.
ex.zh: 地方议会经常开办培训项目，帮助失业居民培养雇主所需的技能。

tip: 过去式ran，过去分词run；现在分词running。

senses.en: To hold a string and let a light toy fly high in the wind.

ex.en: Let us go to the open field and fly a kite.
ex.zh: 我们去开阔的草地上放风筝吧。

ex.en: When the spring wind blows gently, families like to fly a kite in the park.
ex.zh: 春风轻拂时，一家人喜欢去公园里放风筝。

col: fly a kite high｜把风筝放得高高的
go to fly a kite｜去放风筝
fly a kite in spring｜春天放风筝
tip: 动词fly表示“放飞”，单数一只风筝前面要加冠词a。

ex.en: He carried his skateboard home when the rain started.
ex.zh: 开始下雨时，他抱着滑板回家了。

ex.en: Providing dedicated areas for skateboard users can encourage physical activity while reducing conflicts with pedestrians in public spaces.
ex.zh: 为滑板使用者提供专用区域，可以鼓励体育活动，同时减少公共空间中与行人的冲突。

tip: skateboard无扶手；scooter通常有扶手。

senses.en: To sit on a bicycle and pedal it to move along.

ex.en: I can ride a bike around the quiet park path.
ex.zh: 我能沿着安静的公园小路骑自行车。

ex.en: On weekends, my brother and I wear safety helmets when we ride a bike outdoors.
ex.zh: 周末我和哥哥在户外骑自行车时，都会戴上安全头盔。

col: learn to ride a bike｜学骑自行车
ride a bike to school｜骑自行车去上学
ride a bike safely｜安全骑车
tip: bike是bicycle的简写口语形式，意思相同，都与ride搭配。

ex.en: The child carefully carried a bowl of water outside.
ex.zh: 那个孩子小心翼翼地端着一碗水走到外面。

ex.en: Every child should have access to quality education, regardless of family income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都应享有优质教育，不论其家庭收入或居住地点如何。

tip: 复数是children；childish偏贬义，childlike指天真如孩童。

ex.en: Your keys are in the bowl beside the door.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在门边的碗里。

ex.en: Investment in public libraries can help reduce educational inequality and strengthen connections within local communities.
ex.zh: 对公共图书馆的投资有助于减少教育不平等，并加强当地社区内部的联系。

col: in public｜公开地；在公共场合
tip: in two days常指两天后；月份、年份前也用in。

ex.en: We shared a picnic under the trees in the park.
ex.zh: 我们在公园的树下共进了野餐。

ex.en: Providing a park within walking distance of every neighbourhood can encourage exercise and strengthen community ties.
ex.zh: 让每个社区步行可达公园，有助于鼓励锻炼并加强社区联系。

tip: 公园用park；英式英语中停车场用car park。

ex.en: I can carry both bags if you open the door.
ex.zh: 你要是把门打开，我就能把两个袋子都提进去。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet can help rural students benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 稳定的互联网接入能帮助农村学生利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: 作情态动词后接动词原形，第三人称不加s。

ex.en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们一起堆沙堡，玩得特别开心。

ex.en: Making physical activity fun can encourage children to exercise regularly and develop healthier habits throughout their lives.
ex.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童经常锻炼，并养成终身受益的健康习惯。

tip: fun作名词不可数；funny多指好笑的或奇怪的。

ex.en: We caught a fast train and arrived before lunch.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班快车，在午饭前就到了。

ex.en: Fast internet connections allow rural businesses to reach wider markets and compete with companies in major cities.
ex.zh: 高速网络连接使乡村企业能够进入更广阔的市场，并与大城市的公司竞争。

tip: fast本身可作副词，不能说fastly。

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？

ex.en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。

col: help someone with something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

ex.en: I got a warm scarf for my birthday.
ex.zh: 我生日时收到了一条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Students from low-income families may struggle to get the financial support they need to complete university courses.
ex.zh: 低收入家庭的学生可能难以获得完成大学课程所需的经济支持。

tip: 过去式got；美式过去分词也用gotten。

ex.en: Please bring a warm coat when you visit.
ex.zh: 你来时请带一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Improved public transport can bring significant benefits to residents who cannot afford their own cars.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能为买不起私家车的居民带来显著益处。

col: bring someone something｜给某人带来某物
tip: bring强调带到说话者或指定地点；过去式brought。

ex.en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
ex.zh: 狗跳过了大门旁的一摊积水。

ex.en: Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.
ex.zh: 在住房需求持续超过可负担住房供应的城市，住房成本已大幅上涨。

col: jump over a fence｜跳过篱笆
jump at the chance｜欣然抓住机会
a sharp jump in prices｜价格的猛涨
tip: jump at the chance意为欣然抓住机会。

senses.en: To wish or hope to carry out an action or activity.

ex.en: I want to do my math homework before dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 我想在今晚吃晚饭前把数学作业做完。

ex.en: During the winter holiday, many pupils want to do volunteer work in their neighborhood.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，许多小学生想在社区里做志愿服务。

col: want to do homework｜想做作业
want to do something｜想做某事
want to do sports｜想做运动
tip: want后接动作时要用“to + 动词原形”，表示想要做某件事。

ex.en: Hello, would you like to sit next to me?
ex.zh: 你好，你愿意坐在我旁边吗？

ex.en: A simple hello between neighbours can encourage social contact and help newcomers feel welcome in a community.
ex.zh: 邻里之间一句简单的问候就能促进交往，让新来者感受到社区的欢迎。

tip: 电话开头的hello可译为“喂”；say hello to表示向某人问好。

ex.en: I poured some cold milk over my cereal.
ex.zh: 我往麦片上倒了些冷牛奶。

ex.en: Milk provides calcium and protein, although people with certain dietary needs may choose suitable alternatives.
ex.zh: 牛奶提供钙和蛋白质，但有特殊饮食需求的人可以选择合适的替代品。

col: a glass of milk｜一杯牛奶
tip: milk通常不可数；说a glass of milk，不说a milk。

ex.en: She squeezed fresh orange juice into a glass.
ex.zh: 她把鲜橙汁挤进了玻璃杯里。

ex.en: Although fruit juice contains vitamins, eating whole fruit usually provides more fibre and helps limit sugar intake.
ex.zh: 虽然果汁含有维生素，但吃完整的水果通常能摄入更多膳食纤维，并有助于限制糖分摄入。

tip: juice通常不可数；点餐时a juice可指一杯果汁。

ex.en: She sliced a ripe tomato for her cheese sandwich.
ex.zh: 她切了一个熟番茄，放进奶酪三明治里。

ex.en: Growing tomatoes in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 在社区花园种植番茄，可以让城市居民更容易获得新鲜食物。

tip: 复数是tomatoes；英美发音的重读元音不同。

ex.en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the soup.
ex.zh: 她把一根胡萝卜切片，放进汤里。

ex.en: Governments can use tax reductions as a carrot to encourage businesses to invest in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 政府可以用减税作为激励，鼓励企业投资可再生能源。

tip: 比喻奖励或诱因；carrot and stick指奖惩并用。

ex.en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
ex.zh: 我装了一个苹果和一个三明治当午餐。

ex.en: Providing fresh fruit, such as apples, in schools may encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 在学校提供苹果等新鲜水果，可能有助于鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 可数名词；“一个苹果”用an apple。

ex.en: He peeled a banana and sliced it over his cereal.
ex.zh: 他剥了一根香蕉，切成片放在麦片上。

ex.en: Banana farming provides an important source of income for many families in tropical regions.
ex.zh: 香蕉种植为热带地区的许多家庭提供了重要收入来源。

col: a bunch of bananas｜一串香蕉
tip: 可数名词：一根香蕉是a banana。

ex.en: She packed some grapes in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里装了一些葡萄。

ex.en: Farmers growing grapes may need more efficient irrigation systems as summers become hotter and drier.
ex.zh: 随着夏季变得更炎热、更干燥，葡萄种植者可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。

col: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄
tip: 单颗葡萄用a grape，一串用a bunch of grapes。

ex.en: We keep raw meat separate from vegetables in the fridge.
ex.zh: 我们把生肉和蔬菜分开放在冰箱里。

ex.en: Reducing meat consumption may lower the environmental impact of food production in many countries.
ex.zh: 在许多国家，减少肉类消费可能降低食品生产对环境的影响。

tip: 泛指食用肉时不可数；meats指不同种类的肉。

ex.en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 我们看着小鱼在木桥下游动。

ex.en: Eating locally caught fish can support coastal communities, provided that fishing practices protect marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 只要捕捞方式能保护海洋生态系统，食用本地捕获的鱼就能支持沿海社区。

tip: 表示多条鱼通常仍用fish；鱼肉为不可数名词。

ex.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。

ex.en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。

tip: 泛指食物时不可数；foods表示不同种类的食物。

ex.en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
ex.zh: 我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。

ex.en: Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.
ex.zh: 一些居民支持拟建的自行车道，另一些人则担心停车位会减少。

tip: 可修饰复数名词或不可数名词；弱读常为/səm/。

ex.en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里放了新鲜水果。

ex.en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 让新鲜水果价格更亲民，可以鼓励低收入家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: the fruits of your labour｜劳动成果
tip: 泛指水果通常不可数；fruits可指种类或成果。

ex.en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
ex.zh: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving a wider variety of vegetables at lunchtime.
ex.zh: 学校可以在午餐时供应更多种类的蔬菜，鼓励更健康的饮食。

tip: 通常为可数名词；泛指多种蔬菜用vegetables。

ex.en: She cut the apple into slices for her brother.
ex.zh: 她把苹果切成片给弟弟吃。

ex.en: Local councils can cut energy costs by installing efficient lighting in public buildings.
ex.zh: 地方议会可以通过在公共建筑内安装节能照明设备来削减能源开支。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为cut；现在分词为cutting。

senses.en: A word used to give a negative answer or to say something is not true.

ex.en: No, thank you. I do not want any more juice.
ex.zh: 不用了，谢谢。我不想再喝果汁了。

ex.en: "Is that white bird a swan?" "No, it is a tall white crane by the lake."
ex.zh: “那只白鸟是天鹅吗？”“不是，它是湖边一只高大的白鹤。”

tip: 回答一般疑问句时，no和yes是一对反义词；注意no后面常加逗号。

senses.en: used to give a positive answer or agree with someone

ex.en: Yes, I am ready to go to school.
ex.zh: 是的，我已经准备好去上学了。

ex.en: Yes, our class will visit the city science museum next Friday morning.
ex.zh: 是的，我们班下周五上午要去参观市科学博物馆。

tip: 用“Yes”做肯定回答时，后面加逗号，且不能用缩写形式结尾。

senses.en: Meat from a chicken that is cooked and eaten as food.

ex.en: Mom cooked some delicious chicken and rice for our dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 妈妈今晚为我们做了美味的鸡肉和米饭当晚餐。

ex.en: Our school dining hall serves warm chicken soup with fresh vegetables every Wednesday.
ex.zh: 我们学校食堂每周三都会供应搭配新鲜蔬菜的热鸡肉汤。

tip: 作“鸡肉”讲时是不可数名词，不能加s，也不能直接用a修饰。

ex.en: A squirrel buried a nut beside our garden gate.
ex.zh: 一只松鼠在我们花园门旁埋了一颗坚果。

ex.en: Urban parks provide squirrels with food and shelter, although feeding them can alter their natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 城市公园为松鼠提供食物和栖身之所，但投喂可能改变它们的自然行为。

tip: 作动词通常用squirrel away，指悄悄储存。
